name: idle-agents
description: Names the subagents and teammates that reported back and have sat idle since, in a quiet status line at the end of each turn, with the ready SendMessage line to close them. It closes nothing itself.

idleThresholdMinutes.title: Idle threshold (minutes)
idleThresholdMinutes.description: How long an agent sits idle before it is named. 3 minutes is often still a pause between instructions; 30 is usually forgotten. Default: 15.
